name: A moving dot in Aquarius
blurb: A small patch of sky on the ecliptic, the path the planets follow, in the constellation Aquarius. SPHEREx photographed it again and again over two days in June 2025. Watch for the dot that jumps between frames.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 36 hours starting 2025-06-03, at wavelengths from 1.12 to 4.40 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
